prompt:
Our platform team is standing up an integration against VCF Automation in VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 (the successor to vRealize Automation and Aria Automation). We mirror the service catalog into our CMDB on a nightly job, so we need to pull the whole catalog item collection and write it out in an order that diffs cleanly between runs.

Before implementing, research `listCatalogItems` and `getCatalogItem` in the official Broadcom VCF Automation xAPIs reference. Confirm their methods, paths, query parameters, pagination, schemas, status codes, and authentication requirements, and cite the official sources consulted in the final answer. Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Accept: application/json;version=<api_version>`. Use zero-based `page` and explicit `size` for collection paging and never send `$top`, `$skip`, `$orderby`, or `$filter`. Serialize each multi-valued query parameter as one comma-joined value, booleans as lowercase `true` or `false`, and omit every unset optional parameter; an explicitly supplied false value is not unset. Start at page 0 and stop only when the response reports `last: true`, without requesting a later page. De-duplicate accumulated items by `id`, keeping the first occurrence, then sort the complete result by raw Unicode code-point `name`, breaking ties by `id`.

Build a stdlib-only Python package named vcfa_catalog at the repository root, exposing:

  vcfa_catalog.CatalogClient(base_url, token, api_version="9.1.0", page_size=20, timeout=30.0)
    .list_catalog_items(search=None, projects=None, types=None, sort=None, expand=None, expand_projects=None)
        Returns a list of catalog item dicts covering the entire collection.
        projects, types and sort accept a list of strings. expand_projects is
        tri-state: None means the caller did not set it, True and False are both
        values the caller chose.
    .get_catalog_item(item_id, expand=None, expand_projects=None)
        Returns one catalog item dict.

  vcfa_catalog.VcfaApiError
    Raised when an endpoint answers with an error status. Exposes .status_code.

Also provide a command line entry point at python -m vcfa_catalog:

  list-items --base-url URL --token TOKEN [--page-size N] [--search S]
             [--project P]... [--type T]... [--expand-projects]
      Writes one tab-separated "<id>\t<name>" line per catalog item, in the same
      order list_catalog_items returns.

  get-item --base-url URL --token TOKEN --id ID
      Writes the catalog item as JSON.

Constraints:

- Python standard library only. No third-party packages.
- Add only the `vcfa_catalog` package; do not modify existing files.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v` must pass.
